dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000py4l](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000py4l) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 640.71 depth occurred on Mar 11 2025 81km S of Puerto Esperanza. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -10.4958 longitude -70.6144. It impacted 298 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
